Ví dụ giả định: auth 15 ms, profile 60 m: Assume 15 ms authentication, 60 ms profile fetching, 100 ms posts and 10 ms rendering. Profile and posts can run in parallel only if independent after authentication.
Song song giảm wall time, không giảm tổn: Parallelism reduces wall time, not total downstream work. These are fixed illustrative times; end-to-end p99 cannot be obtained by summing or maximizing individual p99s while ignoring distributions and correlations.
Một request mất bao nhiêu round trip?: How many round trips does a request need?
Mô hình giả định DNS cold 30 ms, server: Assume 30 ms cold DNS, 20 ms server processing and no packet loss. TCP plus TLS 1.3 takes two RTTs before HTTP, fresh QUIC one RTT, and connection reuse no new handshake.
Đây là timeline đơn giản, không đo brows: This simplified timeline is not a browser measurement. DNS may need multiple lookups; certificate work, proxies, resumption, transfer size and congestion are omitted. QUIC integrates transport and TLS rather than adding them like TCP plus TLS.
Polling hay server push cho bảng tỉ số?: Polling or server push for a scoreboard?
Giả định một update mỗi 30 giây, snapsho: Assume one update every 30 seconds and 200-byte snapshot/event payloads. Polling returns a snapshot for every request; push sends updates only. Headers, heartbeats, handshakes and reconnections are excluded.
Polling có độ trễ phát hiện trung bình k: Polling detects updates after about half an interval on average if arrivals are uniformly distributed within the cycle. Push needs held connections and backpressure; both SSE and WebSockets retain connection state. Every transport still incurs fan-out costs.
Vì sao latency tăng mạnh gần saturation?: Why does latency rise sharply near saturation?
Mô hình M/M/1 có một server, arrival Poi: The M/M/1 model has one server, Poisson arrivals, exponential service times, a fixed ten-jobs/s service rate and an unbounded queue. It is a teaching model, not a production-latency prediction.
Mô hình có steady state; latency gồm ser: The model has a steady state; latency includes service and queue waiting.
Arrival đạt hoặc vượt service rate: khôn: Arrivals meet or exceed the service rate: this model has no finite steady-state queue.
Hệ thật có nhiều worker, burst, tail và: Real systems have multiple workers, bursts, tails and queue caps and require separate measurements. Admission control bounds waiting and protects dependencies; a queue does not turn sustained overload into capacity.
30 request đến cách nhau 40 ms; mỗi node: Thirty requests arrive 40 ms apart; each node has one serial worker and long jobs follow a fixed schedule. Least outstanding counts running and queued jobs. The model excludes connection pooling and network latency.
Node B xử lý chậm gấp đôi: Node B takes twice as long
Các thanh biểu diễn thời gian bắt đầu và: Bars show each job’s start and finish
Số request bằng nhau chưa chắc lượng côn: Equal request counts need not mean equal work. Outstanding-count policies do not know a new job’s duration; better results on one schedule do not prove a policy wins every workload.
400 key giả định được hash vào vòng 32-b: Four hundred sample keys are hashed onto a 32-bit ring. Each node has virtual tokens; a key moves clockwise to its first token. The baseline has three nodes with the same virtual-token count.
Token trên vòng hash và đường tới owner: Ring tokens and the key’s ownership route
Virtual tokens giúp phân phối nhiều key,: Virtual tokens distribute many keys but do not split one hot key’s load. Routing changes do not migrate data; storage needs replication, ownership versions and migration/catch-up. This illustrative hash is not cryptographic.
LRU, LFU và FIFO trên cùng một request t: LRU, LFU and FIFO on the same request trace
Cache giữ tối đa ba key, mọi object có c: The cache holds three equal-size keys. LFU counts from insertion and uses LRU tie-breaking without aging. Results depend on this trace and are not a general policy benchmark.
Changing the policy replays the same trace from the beginning. FIFO keeps insertion order on hits, LRU updates recency, and LFU retains frequently used keys but can preserve obsolete popularity without decay.
100 key đã có trong cache; tại thời điểm: One hundred keys are cached; ten requests read each key simultaneously at the selected time. Default TTL is 60 seconds; jitter spreads expiry from 45 to 75 seconds. This snapshot counts misses then, not lifetime cache load.
Single-flight trong mô hình hợp nhất mis: The model’s single-flight coalesces same-key misses into one origin load while other requests wait. Jitter spreads expiry across keys but does not coalesce a hot key’s misses. Cross-process coordination requires separate design.
B abort và retry toàn transaction: B aborts and retries the whole transaction
B đọc lại thấy 1 bác sĩ; Bob tiếp tục tr: B rereads one doctor; Bob stays on-call
Vi phạm invariant: không còn bác sĩ trực: Invariant violated: no doctors remain on-call
Write skew: hai transaction, hai row: Write skew: two transactions, two rows
Alice và Bob cùng trực. Mỗi transaction: Alice and Bob are on-call. Each transaction counts doctors and takes one off-call when more than one remains. They update different rows, so preventing same-row lost updates does not preserve the invariant.
Mô hình serializable chọn một transactio: The serializable model aborts one transaction and retries with fresh state. It illustrates an interleaving rather than implementing MVCC/SSI or a lock manager; real engines may abort a different transaction.
Memtable flush khi có ba key distinct. S: The memtable flushes at three distinct keys. Immutable SSTs are read newest-first and tombstones prevent resurrection. Compaction merges all SSTs while retaining tombstones; WALs, Bloom filters, levels and snapshot GC are omitted.
† là tombstone; ∅ là không có value tron: † marks a tombstone; ∅ means no value in this model. Change steps to see C=c1 before deletion and C=† afterwards; compaction must not resurrect c1.
Key-count đều chưa chắc traffic đều: Even key counts do not imply even traffic
1.000 key có ID tăng dần. Chọn 90% traff: One thousand keys have increasing IDs. Direct 90% of traffic to the newest hundred keys or one hot key and compare range/hash partitioning. The model covers placement, not migration or transactions.
Hash giúp trải nhiều key mới, nhưng một: Hashing spreads many new keys, but a hot key still has one owner. More shards can improve key counts without fixing that key’s bottleneck.

A là leader term 1. Entry tại index 1 đã: A is the term-1 leader. The entry at index 1 is committed on all five nodes.
Mạng chia A,B khỏi C,D,E. A append x tại: The network separates A,B from C,D,E. A appends x at index 2 on A,B, but two acknowledgements cannot form a majority of three, so x is not committed.
C được C,D,E bỏ phiếu trong term 2. A vẫ: C receives votes from C,D,E in term 2. Until it hears otherwise, A may still believe it leads term 1; A lacks a quorum to commit.
C replicate y tại index 2, term 2 lên C,: C replicates y at index 2, term 2, to C,D,E and commits it. The x entry on A,B remains uncommitted; two different values have not both committed at index 2.
A,B nhận term 2, A step down. Log x chưa: A,B observe term 2 and A steps down. Uncommitted x is replaced by y, and the nodes apply the committed entry. The committed entry at index 1 remains intact.
Đọc sau khi ghi: trả dữ liệu cũ hay chờ?: Read after write: return stale data or wait?
Session từng đọc version 2, rồi ghi thàn: The session previously read version 2, then successfully wrote version 3 on the primary. Choose the replica version. The watermark requires at least version 3; this model stays still until you advance the replica.
Chờ watermark giữ lời hứa bằng cách chưa: Waiting for the watermark preserves the promise by withholding a result; it does not accelerate replication. Production needs a deadline and an explicit fallback policy.
Quorum: giao nhau và khả năng tiếp tục: Quorums: intersection and ability to proceed
Cùng một tập N home replica cố định. Tập: All requests use the same fixed set of N home replicas. The write set starts at the beginning and the read set at the end to show the smallest intersection. Failures only determine whether enough acknowledgements are possible; the sets are not a live request.
Giao nhau không tự giải quyết concurrent: Intersection does not resolve concurrent writes, partial writes, version ordering or sloppy quorums. This result is not a linearizability certificate.
Raft: leader cũ còn sống, quorum quyết đ: Raft: an old leader can remain alive; quorum decides commit
Đây là năm frame chọn trước, không phải: These are five selected frames, not a complete Raft simulator. Assumptions: initially identical logs, fixed membership and crash faults. Timers, disk flushes, snapshots and other interleavings are omitted. Groups represent a partition only in frames 2–4.
Thêm consumer có luôn tăng parallelism?: Does adding consumers always increase parallelism?
Một classic consumer group đọc một topic: One classic consumer group reads one topic. Each partition has one assigned member; the round-robin mapping below is illustrative, not a particular assignor or rebalance protocol.
Đây là giới hạn assignment của classic g: This is a classic-group assignment limit, not a limit on all processing strategies. Per-key concurrency needs correct ordering and commits; share groups have different semantics.
Crash giữa side effect và ACK: Crash between the side effect and acknowledgement
One event increments a database balance. The first delivery crashes at the selected point; an unacknowledged event is redelivered to completion. A dedup receipt protects the effect only when both commit in one transaction.
The event was acknowledged but its effect was lost.
The effect was repeated after redelivery.
Logical event tạo đúng một effect trong: The logical event produced one effect in this scenario.
This model excludes external payment APIs. Effects outside the transaction need sink cooperation or idempotency, plus reconciliation of unknown outcomes.
Commit offset không được vượt khoảng trố: Committed offsets must not skip gaps
Chọn những offset đã xử lý durable. Comm: Select durably completed offsets. The committed offset is the next record to read and may advance only through a contiguous completed prefix. Complete offset 7 before offset 0 to see why max(completed)+1 can skip work.
Hoàn tất ở đây nghĩa là effect và tiến đ: Completion means the required effect and progress are durable under the contract. Rebalances also need stopping/fencing of stale workers; an offset does not replace ownership.
Window là 1.000 ms; mỗi request tốn một: The window is 1,000 ms and every request costs one unit. Token refill uses limit/second; the leaky queue has that service rate and a separate buffer capacity. Rolling windows use (t−1,000, t].
✓ là nhận vào, × là từ chối; leaky queue: ✓ means admitted and × rejected; leaky-queue admission is not immediate execution. The sliding counter approximates arrivals, not a strict rolling limit. This deterministic replay does not benchmark server performance.
Counter báo 5 nhưng có thể đã cho qua hơ: The counter says 5, but more than 5 may have passed
Counter hiện là 4, limit là 5. Các conte: The counter starts at 4 with a limit of 5. In nonatomic mode contenders read the same state before writing. Compare admitted requests against the final stored counter.
Atomic ở đây là một decision không inter: Atomic means one noninterleaved decision over the same keyed state. Replication/failover, cross-shard keys and durable billing quotas remain separate problems.
Chia 63 bit: không có lựa chọn miễn phí: Allocate 63 bits: every choice has a cost
Giữ sign bit bằng 0. Thay worker bits và: The sign bit stays zero. Change worker and sequence bits; timestamp gets the remainder. The example uses relative time 100,000,000 ms, worker 7 and sequence 3, not a production ID.
Các trần này chỉ đến từ bit layout. Cloc: These ceilings come only from the bit layout. Clock rollback, restart state, worker reuse, thread safety and real throughput need separate designs; allocating bits does not achieve theoretical performance.
Time prefix thay đổi vùng leaf được chạm: Time prefixes change the leaf region touched
B-tree leaf model có tối đa bốn key, spl: The B-tree leaf model holds four keys per leaf and splits in the middle on overflow. Random mode uses a fixed permutation; time mode increases by timestamp groups with reverse order inside each. Buffer pools, internal pages, fill factors and real engines are omitted.
Split count đơn lẻ không chứng minh hiệu: Split counts alone do not establish performance: ordered inserts also split. Observe locality and benchmark the real engine; UUIDv7 within one millisecond does not establish global creation order.
Mỗi component có xác suất khả dụng 99,9%: Each modeled component is available with probability 99.9%. The chain needs every component; the redundant group needs one replica. These are separate structures, not the same architecture.
Lỗi chung có xác suất 1% làm mất cả nhóm: A 1% common-cause failure takes down the entire redundant group
Phép nhân chain giả định độc lập. Nhóm r: The chain product assumes independence. Replicas are conditionally independent without the common failure; adding replicas cannot exceed that common-cause availability ceiling. These are illustrative probabilities, not an SLO forecast from marketing figures.
Retry nhân tải; jitter chỉ trải thời điể: Retries multiply load; jitter only spreads timing
Worst case: mỗi layer gọi layer dưới tối: Worst case: each layer tries the downstream up to the selected total attempt count, including the initial call. The separate chart has 24 failing requests, at most three attempts at one layer and 100/200 ms backoff; each bucket spans 50 ms.
Full jitter cho lịch retry minh họa: Full jitter for the illustrative retry schedule
Đổi layers/attempts tác động phép nhân w: Layers/attempts affect the worst-case multiplier; jitter/budget affect the single-layer chart. Jitter does not reduce total attempts, while budgets cap retries. Deadlines, network latency and dependency recovery are omitted.
Circuit breaker: đóng, mở và probe: Circuit breaker: closed, open and probing
Failure liên tiếp đạt threshold thì open: Consecutive failures reaching the threshold open the breaker for five model time units. After cooldown, admit one probe: success closes it and failure reopens it. This sequential state machine omits concurrent requests and late responses.
Trong half-open, hai nút request biểu di: In half-open, request buttons complete the admitted probe rather than create another. Production must bound concurrency, fence stale responses by generation and choose appropriate metrics/windows rather than merely three consecutive failures.
Mã ngắn chứa được bao nhiêu link?: How many links fit in a short code?
Alphabet cố định: 0–9, a–z, A–Z. Đổi chi: The alphabet is fixed: 0–9, a–z, A–Z. Change namespace length, occupied codes and the ID to inspect encoding. Records are measured in millions; the namespace uses exactly L characters, with optional leading-zero padding.
Nhập từ 1 đến 20 chữ số thập phân, không: Enter 1–20 decimal digits without a sign.
ID vừa namespace đang chọn: The ID fits the selected namespace
ID vượt namespace đang chọn: The ID exceeds the selected namespace
Đọc các ký tự dư từ dưới lên. Đây là enc: Read remainder digits from bottom to top. This is encoding, not encryption.
Hai xác suất trả lời hai câu khác nhau:: The probabilities answer different questions: whether the next draw hits an occupied code, and whether at least one pair collides in n raw draws before deduplication. The birthday approximation assumes independent uniform draws with n small relative to the namespace; a large exponent puts the probability near 100%. Conditional insertion is required even at low collision probability; a full namespace cannot hold another same-length code.
Đổi đích rồi, vì sao trình duyệt vẫn tới: Why does the browser still use an old destination after an update?
Một browser bấm cùng link 10 lần ở giây: One browser follows the same link ten times at seconds 0, 10, …, 90. The origin changes the destination from A to B at the selected time. The replay uses explicit response Cache-Control; it does not simulate heuristic freshness or noncompliant caches.
Đổi 301 ↔ 302 với cùng max-age không xóa: Switching 301 ↔ 302 with the same max-age does not clear a cache. no-cache permits storage but requires validation before reuse; the model counts validation requests as origin contacts. no-store prohibits storing new responses. Clearing a CDN cannot erase browser-cached responses; an origin policy change does not recall a still-fresh copy.
Số mã yêu cầu vượt capacity: cấu hình nà: The requested count exceeds capacity: this configuration cannot exist under the required uniqueness invariant.
Message tìm tới đúng device bằng cách nà: How does a message find the right device?
Bob có phone và desktop. Chuyển từ onlin: Bob has a phone and desktop. Move from both online to the phone reconnecting at another gateway, then to both offline. The registry is a potentially stale routing hint; message history is authoritative for recovery.
Registry chưa nhận thay đổi: The registry has not received the change
Generation phân biệt session cũ/mới, giú: A generation distinguishes old and new sessions so compare-and-delete can prevent an old disconnect from erasing a new session. This model uses one route snapshot: refreshing/retrying or history sync recovers delivery. Push wakes the app but does not replace durable history.
Nhận seq 3 trước seq 2: cursor có được n: Sequence 3 arrives before 2: may the cursor jump to 3?
Log mẫu có 8 committed message với seq l: The example log has eight committed messages with consecutive sequences. Live frames may be delayed, duplicated or missing. Adjust delivery count, then enable sync to fetch history after the contiguous cursor. Each cell is a frame arrival, not a new message.
Không ghi cursor bằng max(seq) khi còn g: Do not save max(seq) as the cursor while a gap remains. Sync may return already buffered entries; deduplicate before applying so the UI does not show them twice. This example intentionally uses consecutive committed sequences. If a real allocator leaves holes, use suitable cursors/skip markers or log offsets rather than waiting for a sequence that will never exist.
Provider đã nhận, worker chết trước khi: The provider accepted, but the worker died before recording status
Durable intent đã tồn tại. Chọn crash bo: A durable intent already exists. Choose a crash boundary, then retry the same delivery intent. The provider-key model assumes the provider retains a real idempotency key long enough, with the same payload and provider; it is not a push collapse key.
Check local status trước khi send không: Checking local status before sending does not close the crash window between provider and database. Pre-marking can lose a send at boundary 0; retrying without provider deduplication can create two acceptances at boundary 1. Provider acceptance does not prove device receipt or user reading.
Replay pipeline: dedup, preferences, cap: Replay a pipeline: deduplication, preferences, caps and retries
Toàn bộ stream mẫu được replay từ đầu mỗ: The entire example stream replays from the beginning whenever configuration changes; this is not production traffic. It contains eight inputs and six distinct event IDs for one recipient. Each delivery encounters exactly N transient failures before acceptance is possible; retries do not spend another marketing admission slot.
Cap ở đây đếm intent được admit theo cha: This cap counts admitted intents per channel, including those eventually dead-lettered; it does not count readers. Transactional work bypasses the example cap but still respects preferences in this model. Production needs category/consent policies, expiry and pre-send rechecks.
Đi từ prefix tới danh sách đã xếp hạng: Walk from a prefix to ranked candidates
Corpus nhỏ được dựng lại trong browser đ: A tiny corpus rebuilds in the browser to illustrate the structure, not benchmark serving. A retired term has a high score but is blocked. Change the candidate budget to see how filtering after top-K can underfill results.
Fold dấu tiếng Việt theo policy mẫu: Fold Vietnamese accents under the example policy
Loại term khi build: Exclude the term at build time
Xem corpus và score mẫu: Inspect the example corpus and scores
NFC làm các biểu diễn canonically equiva: NFC unifies canonically equivalent representations. Removing accents and mapping the Vietnamese crossed d to plain d are extra example policies, not default Unicode normalization. The example does not perform fuzzy matching; bounded overfetch can still return fewer than K results when many candidates are filtered.
Response cũ về sau có ghi đè từ đang gõ: Can a late old response overwrite the current input?
Ba request được gửi cho c, ca và cat. Re: Three requests are sent for c, ca and cat. The c request is slowest. Adjust the clock or enable a generation guard; this is a timestamp replay, not a live network. The guard applies only the current generation and clears old results when input changes.
Chỉ apply response khớp input generation: Apply only responses matching the input generation
Abort request là tối ưu tài nguyên, khôn: Aborting is a resource optimization, not a replacement for generation checks: responses/callbacks can still race. Update the guard as soon as input changes, not only when a debounce timer sends a new request. Query, locale, tenant and personalization context also belong to request identity.
Thêm worker có làm một host được crawl n: Can more workers crawl one host arbitrarily faster?
Có 10 job trên ba host, duration cố định: Ten jobs span three hosts with fixed durations. Polite mode allows at most one in-flight fetch per host and a minimum interval between starts. This is a configured interval, not an assumption that Crawl-delay belongs to the robots standard.
Đọc lịch fetch dạng văn bản: Read the fetch schedule as text

Bloom filter tiết kiệm RAM đổi lấy điều: What does a Bloom filter trade for memory savings?
Thiết kế cho 10 tỷ URL. Đổi bit mỗi URL: The design capacity is ten billion URLs. Adjust bits per designed URL and actual insertion load. The formula assumes a standard Bloom filter, uniform hashing, intact bits and no deletion; it is not a measured implementation false-positive rate.
Positive → bỏ URL. Nhanh nhưng có thể mấ: Positive → skip the URL. Fast, but false positives can reduce coverage; the estimated skip count above applies only to this policy.
Negative → chưa có; positive → kiểm stor: Negative → absent; positive → check an authoritative store. This avoids false-positive coverage loss but adds lookups; Bloom does not replace atomic enqueue/seen state.
No false negatives chỉ đúng với thành vi: No false negatives applies only to inserted members with correct state/hashing. Lost bits, resets or unsuitable deletion can break that assumption. Enqueue races can lose jobs even when the filter is correct; a filter alone does not guarantee loop-free or lossless crawling.
High rendition lỗi có cần chặn toàn bộ p: Must a failed high rendition block all playback?
Clock là thời gian mô phỏng: probe xong: The simulation clock completes probing at 1, low at 5, mid at 8 and high at 12; a failed first high attempt finishes retrying at 20. Controls replay the entire scenario. Publication gates still apply to a minimal ladder; this does not simulate actual codecs or moderation.
Publish khi low + mid đã đủ: Publish when low + mid are sufficient
Publish gate đã được duyệt trong scenari: The publication gate is approved in this scenario
Chỉ manifest trỏ tới artifact đã validat: Publish only manifests referencing validated artifacts. Progressive publication changes time-to-playable without inherently reducing total encoding work; high completion publishes a new manifest version. Artifacts may be encoded while an unapproved gate still prevents public serving.
Bitrate cao hơn có luôn cho trải nghiệm: Does a higher bitrate always improve the experience?
Replay 12 segment với ladder 0,4 / 0,8 /: Replay twelve segments using a 0.4 / 0.8 / 1.5 / 3 / 6 Mbps ladder. Each rule chooses from the pre-download estimate, updated with an EWMA afterward. The buffer rule uses safety factors and lowers its budget below eight seconds of buffer. RTT, maximum-buffer pacing and codec quality are not simulated.
Download time = segment seconds × chosen: Download time = segment seconds × chosen Mbps / available Mbps. Startup is separate from rebuffering. The chart stops after twelve downloads, not after the video finishes; remaining buffered media continues playing. A safety rule cannot guarantee stall-free playback below the ladder or with delayed estimates.
CDN hit cao có làm viewer egress biến mấ: Does a high CDN hit rate eliminate viewer egress?
Concurrent viewers được giữ liên tục tro: The example holds concurrent viewers constant for one hour. Hits use a CDN byte-hit ratio; remaining bytes reach the origin, excluding shielding/coalescing and overhead. This is capacity arithmetic, not service pricing.
Cache giảm origin fill, không xóa byte C: Caching reduces origin fills without removing viewer-delivered bytes. Request-hit ratios cannot replace byte-hit ratios when segment sizes vary. A warm-cache scenario does not establish origin capacity during cold starts or cache outages.
Thay một byte và chèn một byte khác nhau: How do replacing and inserting one byte differ?
Demo dùng ASCII một byte/ký tự và fixed-: The demo uses one-byte ASCII characters and tiny fixed-size chunks for visibility. It compares exact chunk content rather than running real hashes/storage. Identical content shares labels; uploaded bytes count unique new chunks within the example scope.
Chèn byte ở đầu: Insert a byte at the start
In-place edit thường chỉ đổi chunk chứa: In-place edits usually change their containing chunk; insertions shift subsequent fixed boundaries. CDC can resynchronize content-based boundaries without guaranteeing only one changed chunk. Re-exporting, compression or encryption can rewrite almost every byte; deltas are not always small.
Hai device cùng sửa report.bin từ revisi: Two devices edit report.bin from revision 5
Cả A và B bắt đầu từ cùng revision rồi t: A and B start from the same revision and produce different content. The clock represents stages, not timestamps selecting a winner. Stage four is an explicit keep-both decision using a new file ID, not automatic binary merging.
Bản local chưa commit được giữ lại để re: The uncommitted local version is retained for resolution
CAS từ chối stale parent; client giữ loc: CAS rejects stale parents; clients keep local bytes and can create conflict copies idempotently. Disabling the guard illustrates a silent overwrite, not deletion of all version history. The model does not simulate journal cursors, crash-safe filesystem application or rename/delete races.
Vòng tròn tìm kiếm có nằm gọn trong một: Does a search circle fit inside one cell?
Map là mặt phẳng 10 × 10 km minh họa, kh: The map is a ten-by-ten-kilometer teaching plane, not real lat/lon coordinates or routes. Covering selects fixed cells intersecting the radius bounding box, followed by Euclidean distance filtering. Real geohash/H3 queries need spherical covers and latitude/dateline handling.
Chỉ đọc cell chứa query để thấy false ne: Read only the query cell to expose false negatives
Exact filtering loại false positives; nó: Exact filtering removes false positives but cannot recover unretrieved points. Smaller cells increase cover counts while often reducing candidate amplification; this is not a latency benchmark.
Quadtree chia nhỏ nơi có nhiều địa điểm: A quadtree subdivides densely populated areas
Root chứa 12 point, hoặc thêm 16 point t: The root contains twelve points, optionally with sixteen more in a cluster. Over-capacity leaves split into four until maximum depth. Duplicate or tightly clustered points can still exceed capacity at that cap; subdivision is bounded.
Thêm cluster 16 point gần nhau: Add a cluster of sixteen nearby points
Leaf geometry và membership được tính lạ: Leaf geometry and membership update with the controls. This is an adaptive partition, not an H3/geohash encoder. Quadtree searches prune nonintersecting nodes before exact filtering; balancing, persistence and concurrent writes are not simulated.
Ô được tô nền là candidate cells; đường: Shaded cells hold candidates, the dashed circle shows the radius and the cross marks the query. Larger points are exact matches. The lists below preserve IDs and distances without relying on color.
Tìm key khác nhau mà không gửi lại cả ra: Locate differing keys without resending an entire range
Hai replica giữ cùng 8 key theo cùng thứ: Two replicas hold the same eight keys in identical order and range boundaries. Toggle keys to change B, then step through comparisons. H-labels symbolize canonical subtree identities rather than cryptographic hashes or benchmarks. Production needs collision-resistant digests and consistent version/tombstone encodings.
Mỗi hàng là một depth. Cặp bằng nhau dừn: Each row is a depth. Equal pairs stop at that branch; differing pairs descend to children. Differing leaves require fetching/reconciling records under version policies, not automatically choosing A or B as the winner.
Tree comparison giảm data exchange khi n: Comparisons reduce data exchange when many subtrees match, but building trees still reads/hashes data and repairs consume IO/network. Matching roots require identical key ranges, snapshot/repair semantics and canonical encodings. Hash collisions/corruption are not simulated.
Timeout không nói rằng capture chưa xảy: A timeout does not mean capture did not happen
Scenario giả định PSP đã capture ở stage: The scenario assumes capture at stage two with a lost response. Stage four selects recovery or retry. Controls replay the scenario without real PSP calls. Without deduplication coverage, this model allows another charge; specific APIs may have additional resource/amount guards.
Có provider reference đã lưu bền và API: A durable provider reference and suitable lookup API are available
Same payload/key còn trong dedup retenti: The same payload/key remains within the original PSP deduplication window
A key is not automatically a searchable provider ID. Queries resolve only with suitable references/lookup contracts; without them the outcome remains UNKNOWN. Keys do not deduplicate across PSPs; expired windows or changed logical attempts need explicit recovery rather than blind retries.
Ledger cân bằng vẫn có thể ghi trùng tiề: A balanced ledger can still duplicate money
Ví dụ một currency với integer minor uni: The example uses one currency with integer minor units: capture 10000, a five-percent platform fee and ninety-five-percent seller payable. Two distinct refunds use the slider amount and return proportional fees before settlement/payout. This illustrative policy excludes PSP fees, taxes and FX.
Unique posting theo financial operation,: Enforce unique postings by financial operation, beyond event IDs
Delivery gồm capture event lặp, event ID: Deliveries include a repeated capture event, a distinct event for that same capture, a repeated refund-1 and a separate refund-2. Disable the guard to see balanced journals overstate actual provider assets.
Balance equality chỉ kiểm bookkeeping, k: Balance equality checks bookkeeping rather than correct amounts, account mappings or deduplication. Production needs atomic posting transactions, scoped operation uniqueness, currency checks and available/refundable-funds constraints. This guard illustrates duplicate persistence rather than a full accounting/reconciliation engine.
Một score event bị phát lại làm rank đổi: How does replaying a score event change ranks?
Server source cung cấp absolute total và: The source provides absolute totals and increasing player/season versions. The stream includes duplicates, stale versions and delayed retries. Apply absolute score bằng monotonic sour: Apply absolute scores using monotonic source versions
Ties dùng descending ASCII member để khớ: Ties use descending ASCII members to match Redis REV in this fixture. Ordinal means unique positions; competition/dense ranks are different product definitions. Demo reads share one frozen replay state rather than mixing times.
Absolute update chỉ an toàn nếu aggregat: Absolute updates depend on correct source aggregates, monotonic player/season versions and atomic version-check/score writes. Incremental updates can use other deduplication protocols; the demo does not declare every incremental design incorrect.
Global rank cần những gì từ mỗi shard?: What does global rank need from each shard?
24 player thuộc cùng frozen snapshot; or: Twenty-four players share a frozen snapshot ordered by descending scores then ASCII IDs. Fixture indexes assign partitions. Shards return local top-K and counts of preceding tuples, including ties. Network and distributed snapshot protocols are not simulated.
Histogram dùng buckets rộng 25 points củ: The full frozen fixture has twenty-five-point histogram buckets, yielding rank intervals rather than exact ranks independently of partial shard replies. Global top-K proofs require all shards, common orders/filters and consistent cuts. The fixture supplies target tuples; production must obtain correct versions before counting.
Một click đến trễ thuộc window nào?: Which window contains a late-arriving click?
Fixture một ad, một input partition, win: The fixture has one ad, one input partition and sixty-second [start,end) windows. After each arrival, progress follows maximum observed event time minus lag. Events use the preceding watermark; windows emit at end and retire at end plus allowed lateness. This second-based convention is a teaching model, not a full Flink simulator.
Chấm đặc là event time, chấm rỗng là arr: Solid dots mark event times, hollow dots mark arrivals and the dashed line marks current progress, clamped to zero when negative. The fixture retains all click identities. TTLs, multiple partitions/idleness and fraud rules are not simulated.
Summary giữ lịch sử để nhìn lại dù live: Summaries retain history for inspection after live-state retirement. Progress-based closure does not prove billing finality or that all future late clicks arrived. Side outputs remain raw evidence requiring recount/adjustment policies.
Upsert absolute count đã đủ chống stale: Do absolute upserts prevent stale overwrites?
Cùng window có stream r1=2, r2=3, r1 rep: One window receives stream r1=2, r2=3, a repeated r1, a generation-two recount of four, an old generation-one r3 of three and a repeated recount. The fixture assumes generation two is legitimately published. Compare additive misuse, blind upserts and fenced generations/revisions.
Version fence chỉ đúng khi key/dimension: Version fences require validated key/dimension/rule scopes, authorized generations and atomic comparisons/writes. Conflicting counts at the same version need investigation rather than last-write-wins handling. Transactional sinks are another option; this model does not replace connector/OLAP-engine semantics.
Đặt hai đêm phải thành công cả hai hoặc: A two-night stay commits both nights or neither
Fixture cố định mô phỏng hai race patter: The fixed fixture covers last-room races across two nights and an available first night followed by a full second night. Atomic mode checks/reserves the whole stay; naive mode uses stale checks or leaks partial writes. This does not execute real SQL transactions.
Atomic whole-stay check, update và rollb: Atomic whole-stay checks, updates and rollback
Atomic mode biểu diễn guarantee cần đạt,: Atomic mode represents the required guarantee rather than proving every SQL statement/isolation level correct. Production needs expected calendar rows, consistent multi-lock order and bounded idempotent retries for aborts, deadlocks and ambiguous commits.
Payment tới muộn có được hồi sinh hold đ: Can late payment revive an expired hold?
Capacity một chỗ. A giữ từ t0 tới deadli: Capacity is one. A holds from t0 until t10; payment starts at t5 and times out locally at t7. A sweeper runs at t11 and B tries at t13. Late A captures at t12 with a t15 callback; timely A captures at t8 with a t9 callback. B has separate verified payment. Controls replay the scenario without rewinding real providers.
A được confirm trước hold deadline: A is confirmed before the hold deadline
Confirm kiểm active hold, version và exp: Confirmation validates active holds, versions and expiry
Guard giữ inventory invariant nhưng khôn: The guard preserves inventory without automatically refunding money. Late-paid A needs validated reacquisition or separately identified recoverable refunds/compensation. Deadlines are business policies: UNKNOWN is not failed, and expiry does not cancel in-flight provider calls.
A và B cùng thấy một phòng còn trống trê: A and B both observe one available room on each night
B kiểm lại trong atomic boundary và nhận: B rechecks under the atomic boundary and is sold out
Night 1 is available; night 2 is full

Đêm 1 bị trừ; đêm 2 fail nhưng không rol: Night 1 decremented; night 2 fails without rollback
Thêm một label có thể tạo bao nhiêu seri: How many series can one extra label create?
Base Cartesian bound là 30 services ×4 m: The Cartesian upper bound is 30 services ×4 methods ×8 status values ×3 regions =2880 combinations. Average có che spike và làm sai global m: Can averages hide spikes and distort the global mean?
23 gauge samples cách đều, gồm spike100: There are 23 regularly spaced gauge samples, including a spike at 100. The last bucket may contain fewer samples. Each bucket retains its minimum, maximum, sum and count. The weighted mean divides total sums by total counts; averaging bucket means fails when counts differ. Time weighting with sample gaps and counter resets is outside this model.
Giữ min/max bên cạnh average: Retain minima and maxima alongside averages
Nét liền là raw gauge; nét đứt là bucket: The solid line shows raw gauges and the dashed line shows bucket means. Extrema bars and maximum markers appear only when retained. An average of 19 cannot reconstruct the original peak at 100; this chart is not a request-latency histogram.
Min/max/sum/count chưa đủ để dựng arbitr: Minima, maxima, sums and counts cannot reconstruct arbitrary percentiles or reset-aware counter rates. Merging latency distributions requires compatible histograms or sketches; time-weighted gauge averages need explicit duration and gap policies.
Alert for: 3m có nghĩa là ba lần true li: Does an alert duration of three minutes mean three consecutive true evaluations?
Rule input là error-rate % đã tính sẵn,: The rule receives precomputed error percentages and evaluates once per minute. Minutes 2–3 contain a brief spike; minutes 7–14 contain sustained errors. Rule expression không có dữ liệu ở t10: Remove the rule expression result at minute 10
Markers: P pending, F firing, ? no data,: Markers: P pending, F firing, ? no data, — inactive. The dashed line is the threshold; gaps are not plotted as zero errors. Notification grouping, query errors, lookback/staleness and keep_firing_for are outside this model.
Absent data cần telemetry-health policy: Missing data needs a separate telemetry-health policy rather than being treated as healthy zero. Alert label identities must remain stable: putting changing values in labels can create new instances and reset pending durations. SLO burn-rate and multi-window policies require additional design rather than merely lengthening the pending duration to silence pages.
Một viewport nhỏ giữa hàng nghìn tỷ tile: A small viewport among trillions of tiles
Đây là lưới giả định với tiles 256 px và: This synthetic grid uses 256 px tiles and a 768 ×512 px viewport offset from tile boundaries. Dijkstra và A*: cùng bài toán, khác thứ: Dijkstra and A*: the same objective, different exploration
Đồ thị giả định có 40 nodes, roads hai c: The synthetic graph has forty nodes, two-way roads and two bridges across a boundary. Đóng cầu giữa: hard constraint: Close the middle bridge: a hard constraint
Node có viền đậm đã settled trong replay: Heavily outlined nodes are settled in the replay. The heavy solid path appears when searching finishes. Heuristic phải dùng cùng đơn vị với cost: Heuristics must use the same units as costs. Here, every km costs at least one minute, so straight-line km lower-bound minutes and traffic only raises costs. Real graphs require valid conversions and bounds before using distances to guide time-cost searches.
Traffic cũ hoặc ít probes nên được tin đ: How much should stale or sparse traffic probes be trusted?
Một đoạn đường giả định dài 10 km, histo: A synthetic segment is ten km long with historical speed 40 km/h. The experiment uses trust = min(1, samples/20) ×exp(−age/300), expiring after 600 seconds. This illustrative policy is neither a trained ETA model nor an uncertainty estimate.
Khi samples =0 hoặc age trên 600 giây, m: Zero samples or ages above 600 seconds trigger historical fallback. Blending speeds and then dividing distance by speed differs from averaging travel times and does not forecast conditions on arrival. Closures and legal restrictions remain separate hard constraints: historical fallback speeds must not reopen prohibited roads.

Reductions preserve priority; replacements always renew it under these rules. Auctions, fees, hidden orders and self-trade prevention are absent. Arrays expose state rather than simulate production latency.

At #12 the same business ID/payload returns the old result without new executions. At #13 only 3/10 lots match and 7 expire; market orders cannot create liquidity.
Fill ID = committed log index / ordinal,: Fill ID = committed log index / ordinal, stable across leadership epochs.
HALT ở #15 và RESUME ở #17 là logged con: HALT at #15 and RESUME at #17 are logged controls. These rules permit cancel/reduce during halts but reject new orders; rejected business IDs remain retained. Current wall clocks do not alter replay results.

Checkbox biểu diễn evidence từ authority: The checkbox represents evidence from external authority/output sinks, not self-authorization. Full-state equality is a direct comparison, not a cryptographic checksum or proof of production correctness. Republishing old fill IDs requires downstream deduplication; epochs fence writers without changing a fill’s business identity.
Hai symbol không được tiêu cùng một acco: Two symbols cannot spend the same account budget twice
Hai shards A/B cùng nhìn thấy budget 1.0: Shards A/B both observe 1,000 and request reservations of 700 and 600 credit units. The lab omits fills, fees and price changes; it models budget reservations rather than actual margin. Guarded mode uses atomic reservations and releases deduplicated by reservation ID.
Invariant: available + reserved A + rese: Invariant: available + reserved A + reserved B = 1,000, with nonnegative available credit. Without guards, step 4 over-reserves by 300 and step 6 invents 700 credit through a duplicate release. Guards preserve the invariant and accept only A. Stale prechecks over-reserve; missing release identities inflate credit.
Trong production có thể dùng account aut: Production can use an account authority, conservative escrow quotas or other justified coordination, each with latency/utilization costs. Reconcile unknown outcomes before reserving/releasing again. Post-trade kill switches do not turn stale prechecks into hard pre-trade limits.
